messages:
ashwin: Quick preflight — noticed p95 drift on the staging canary after yesterday's kernel tweak. Need a short benchmark run (5–10m) for small/med/long seqs and p50/p95/p99. Can we get numbers and a quick call on go/no-go in 30m? @maria @alex
maria: On it, kicking off a 5m microbench against canary group A (4xA100). Will tag results. ETA ~8m.
ops-bot: Deploy event: canary v2.3 -> group A started (deploy_id: dply-2040001, trace: 0x7f9c).
alex: Heads up — I rolled kernel back on one host to isolate impact. If possible run the bench against both variants (kernel-current vs kernel-rolled) so we can compare.
ashwin: Good plan. Please prefix results with 'kernel-current' or 'kernel-rolled' in the output.
maria: Posting raw summary now: 
```
kernel-current - small seq: p50 12ms / p95 28ms / p99 65ms
kernel-rolled  - small seq: p50 11ms / p95 24ms / p99 60ms

kernel-current - med seq:   p50 45ms / p95 98ms / p99 150ms
kernel-rolled  - med seq:   p50 44ms / p95 95ms / p99 148ms

kernel-current - long seq:  p50 220ms / p95 420ms / p99 730ms
kernel-rolled  - long seq:  p50 215ms / p95 400ms / p99 690ms
```

maria: TL;DR: measurable regression on long seq p95 (~5–8%), small/med within noise. p99 bigger but low sample count.
dev-bench-bot: Profiles uploaded -> s3://redwood-bench/2040001111/run-1.tar.gz (contains traces + perf maps).
tim: I can generate flamegraphs for the long-seq samples and compare kernel paths. Will start now, ~25m for initial.
ashwin: If flamegraphs point to attention kernel regression we HOLD. If it's IO/scheduling, we can consider progressing. @tim please prioritize flamegraph for long seq.
tim: Copy. Also will run a quick perf stat across the two hosts to see syscalls/sched-steal.
sophie: From release side: QA will run smoke tests on v2.3 but final rollout is blocked pending eng sign-off. For decision UI: :thumbsup: hold, :white_check_mark: proceed.
alex: Based on these numbers I vote hold until we see flamegraphs. :thumbsup:
maria: Acknowledged — pausing any promotion steps and blocking the automated rollout.
ashwin: Thanks everyone. Tim, please ping here with flamegraphs or perf output. If we don't see a kernel-level regression within 40m we can reassess auto-unpause.
bench-bot: Note: if canary hold > 60m, incident channel will be auto-created (policy: canary-hold-escalation).
ashwin: Will monitor. If we need to rollback, proposed steps: 1) pause promotions 2) promote v2.2 to capacity floor 3) collect extended logs for 1h -> postmortem.
tim: Flamegraph upload ETA ~23m: s3://redwood-bench/2040001111/flamegraphs.tar.gz
ashwin: Perfect. Closing for now — thanks for the quick turnaround.
